title: Smoky Oat Salad Bowl
description: A hearty and healthy salad bowl made with smoky oats, fresh greens, and a tangy zesty dressing.

ingredients.name: Smoky Oats
ingredients.notes: cooking instructions: boil in 2 cups water for 5 minutes

ingredients.name: Mixed Greens
ingredients.notes: any combination of kale, spinach, arugula

instructions: Cook the smoky oats according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens.
Drizzle the zesty dressing over the greens.
Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste.
